content.title: Wendy’s are handing out free frosty and fries on April 7 thanks to their iconic ‘dunk’ promotion
content.text: TODAY, family diner Wendy’s is handing out free fries and ice cream – thanks to the first dunk of the basketball championships. Fans of fast food are in for a treat as Wendy’s is giving away one small fries and one small Frosty Classic per person at their restaurants across the US. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! The offer is a slam dunk for fans of fries and ice cream – but only while stocks lastCredit: Getty The free goodies are available upon request in Wendy’s restaurants only on April 7, the date of the first dunk in the NCAA March Madness. Customers can pick a Small Hot & Crispy Fry and pair with either a Small Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty Classic. The iconic diner unlocked the nationwide offer earlier today to celebrate the first dunk in the US Basketball championships, calling it “free dunks for America”. Wendy’s are official partners with NCAA March Madness and this free fries and ice cream promotion is their off-court slam-dunk for customers. According to the US restaurant chain, the menu celebrates “the most memorable plays both on and off court”. A slam dunk in Basketball involves the player jumping up and forcing the ball through the net with one or both hands – but in Wendy’s case, the only two-handed dunk is customers seizing their fries and ice cream freebies. Fans of the fast-food diner are delighted. “My 7 year old is gonna be pumped!” posted one enthusiastic parent on X. Most read in Money “I’m game”, posted another, punning on the Basketball theme. Wendy’s Dunk Menu was unveiled on March 16, and every purchase from the Dunks Menu via the Wendy’s app earned fans a chance to win prizes from Wendy’s Dunkstakes, including custom dunk-inspired sneakers, multiple $1,000 cash prizes, and a grand cash prize of $100,000. “It’s the signature play fans have known and loved for years, and this season we’re turning up the excitement with even more crave-worthy ways to enjoy Wendy’s all tournament long”, said Lindsay Radkoski, a spokesperson for Wendy’s. Another major US retailer is offering massive savings across April. Costco’s latest rotation of bargain must-haves rolled out yesterday – and only lasts until the end of the month. Slashed price buys include men’s crew neck t-shirts, women’s sports shorts, Dyson vacuum cleaners and 6-piece sofas. Several of the items on offer have high customer reviews, with the women’s shorts nabbing a strong 4.8 out of five stars. The six-piece modular gray sofa, which is selling for less than half price, had 2,300 satisfied buyers rate it a collective 4.7 out of five stars. Comments
